concept.zh: 有重复需求的最短连续区间
concept.en: Shortest consecutive window with repeated requirements

brief.zh: strip 是按顺序贴好的零件标签，need 是要收回的标签清单，重复的标签要找足份数。选一段连续的 strip 覆盖整张清单。返回最短区间的 [起点, 终点]，从 0 编号并含两端，等长取起点最早的一段。清单为空或凑不齐就返回 []。
brief.en: strip is a row of part labels and need is a recall list. Repeated labels require that many copies. Return the inclusive, zero-based [start, end] of the shortest continuous section covering the entire list. Prefer the earliest start on ties. Return [] for an empty request or if it cannot be filled.

label.en: Include a label at the right
Keep the latest window on a tie
